---
title: "Cloud"
---

Much of CMIP6 is also available in public cloud storage, which may be faster
than downloading from WHOI if you compute in the cloud:

- [Pangeo / Google Cloud CMIP6](https://pangeo-data.github.io/pangeo-cmip6-cloud/):
  Zarr stores with an intake-esm catalog.
- [AWS Open Data CMIP6](https://registry.opendata.aws/cmip6/): the same
  collection on Amazon S3.
- [ERA5 on AWS](https://registry.opendata.aws/ecmwf-era5/) and other public
  ERA5 mirrors.

Use the WHOI server when you work on the WHOI cluster, need a dataset that is
not in the cloud collections, or need the exact files used in an earlier WHOI
analysis. The cloud copies can differ from ESGF and from each other in version
and format; check `version` and the dataset attributes before mixing sources.
